statement:
Find an arithmetic progression of 2016 natural numbers such that none of them is a perfect power but their product is a perfect power.

Clarification: A perfect power is a number of the form \(n^k\) where \(n, k \geq 2\) are natural numbers.

For an integer \(m \geq 3\), define \(S(m) = 1 + \dfrac{1}{3} + \dfrac{1}{4} + \cdots + \dfrac{1}{m}\) (the term \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) is excluded; all fractions \(\tfrac{1}{k}\) for integers \(k\) from 3 to \(m\) are included). Let \(n \geq 3\) and \(k \geq 3\). Compare the quantities \(S(nk)\) and \(S(n) + S(k)\).

Agustín and Lucas take turns marking a cell that has not yet been marked on a \(101 \times 101\) grid. Agustín starts. A cell cannot be marked if it already has two marked cells in its row or in its column. The player who cannot make a move loses. Determine which player has a winning strategy.
Find the angles of a convex quadrilateral \(ABCD\) such that \(\angle ABD = 29^\circ\), \(\angle ADB = 41^\circ\), \(\angle ACB = 82^\circ\), and \(\angle ACD = 58^\circ\).

Let \(a\) and \(b\) be rational numbers such that \(a + b = a^2 + b^2\). Suppose the common value \(s = a + b = a^2 + b^2\) is not an integer, and write it as an irreducible fraction \(s = \dfrac{m}{n}\). Let \(p\) be the smallest prime divisor of \(n\). Find the minimum value of \(p\).

Let \(AB\) be a segment of length 1. Several particles start simultaneously from \(A\) and move at constant speeds towards \(B\); as soon as a particle reaches \(B\) it turns around and heads to \(A\); when it reaches \(A\) it turns and moves towards \(B\) again, and so on indefinitely. Find all rational numbers \(r > 1\) such that there exists an instant \(t\) with the following property: for each \(n \geq 1\), if \(n+1\) particles with constant speeds \(1, r, r^2, \ldots, r^n\) move as described, at instant \(t\) they all lie at the same interior point of segment \(AB\).
